name: Margaret Higgins
psychographics: Values privacy above convenience; believes face-to-face interaction is superior to digital mediation.
current_solutions: Uses a landline telephone and writes cheques for bills; avoids smartphones and smart TVs entirely.
frustration: Tried to renew her bus pass at the council office at 2pm on Tuesday; the machine was 'out of service' and the receptionist said 'everything is online now', forcing her to ask a stranger to use their phone to book a ticket.
decision_style: reads leaflets thoroughly, asks neighbours for advice, and avoids anything that requires an account setup.
voice: Soft-spoken and deliberate, often pauses mid-sentence to recall a detail; refers to technology as 'those machines'.
